summary: Semantic signoff required for A2A/NATS marathon build fix spec
body: You are being asked for semantic signoff or blocker amendment on the active A2A/NATS master spec for a marathon build fix. Read these artifacts in the repo: reports/a2a/NATS_CONNECT_RECOVERY_SPEC_20260617.md and reports/a2a/A2A_MASTER_SPEC_WORKING_STATE_20260617.md . Return a response artifact with exactly: status=approved or blocked, exact_issue_list (the exact issues you think are real), blocking_issues, required_changes, and whether the Mac-side lane is non-canonical for you. Transport ACK does not count. Only semantic review counts.
